hints.title: Multiple sources
hints.body: Every zero is a starting point at distance zero.

hints.title: Spread outward
hints.body: From the current frontier, unvisited neighbors get distance one more than their source.

hints.title: Breadth-first order
hints.body: A queue visits cells in nondecreasing distance, so the first time a cell is reached is optimal.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
dist = grid of -1
queue = empty
for each cell with grid[r][c] == 0:
    dist[r][c] = 0
    queue.push((r, c))
while queue not empty:
    r, c = queue.pop_front()
    for each edge-neighbor (nr, nc):
        if inside and dist[nr][nc] == -1:
            dist[nr][nc] = dist[r][c] + 1
            queue.push((nr, nc))
return dist
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
